newsitem.title: USA: Uranium Resources to buy mineral interests.
newsitem.headline: Uranium Resources to buy mineral interests.

text.p: Uranium Resources Inc said on Monday it has signed a letter of intent with Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp under which it would acquire for exploration and development potential certain uranium mineral interests in exchange for 1.2 million shares of common stock and a commitment to expand certain amounts of exploration.
The mineral interests cover about 500,000 acres in northwestern New Mexico, the company said.

The company said that more than a quarter of the total acreage comprised uranium mineral rights and about two-thirds of the acreage comprised exploration rights with rights to purchase and develop any uranium mineral interests found. Included in the purchase is an existing royalty obligation from the company to Santa Fe on certain properties currently under lease from Santa Fe.

Completion of the deal -- which is expected within 120 days -- is subject to approval by the boards of both companies, certain regulatory conditions and the preparation of a definitive document, the company said.
